name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding Manager | Implementation, Training & Enablement, AI-Enabled Workflows
summary: Onboarding and enablement lead who gets customers from kickoff to confident, measurable use. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets, including e-commerce launches for established retail businesses, and trained onboarding teams of up to 30. At Birdeye I tracked partner utilization to catch low adoption early and retained all but one of 15-20 (~94%). I use AI every day to research, draft documentation, and personalize customer communication, and I grade AI output against a rubric before it reaches a customer.

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LLM APIs) to streamline workflows, draft documentation and customer communication, and research clients; grade AI output against rubric-based criteria I built.
Run discovery with business owners to confirm goals and use cases, then guide them through the change from manual processes to automated workflows.
Wrote and published 18 plain-language articles that explain technical topics to non-technical readers.
Build reporting on a regular cadence tracking progress and outcomes, turning the data into specific recommendations for each client.
